title: starknet-contracts
tagline: A basic implementation of the cross chain contracts for 1inch cross swap
description: By using the current evm example and the white paper, we created the required contracts to make the cross swap from starknet to evm and viceversa. All cairo contracts are there, those have been deployed into devnet to make the test locally. Basically is an script + contracts to make the implementation.
how_its_made: By using cairo, we created all the contracts required for the resolver, scrow, etc. Using cairo for starknet the porject has all the required contracts to make the cross chain swap from and evm to starknet and the way back too. It is all deplyed with scarb locally for starknet  and suing the evm exmaple.
